description: This file defines the class BaseContainerIterator, which implements an iterator over container IDs, providing methods to navigate, reset, and access container identifiers within the WPEFramework's ProcessContainers namespace.

classes.name: BaseContainerIterator
classes.description: An iterator class for traversing container IDs, supporting navigation and validation functionalities.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next container ID, returning true if the new position is valid.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the previous container ID, returning true if the new position is valid.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator to an initial invalid position.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: Index
methods.description: Returns the current index of the iterator.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the total number of container IDs.

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Returns the container ID at the current iterator position.
